ui.description: Join two FIT files into one activity, or trim one you forgot to stop: fix a run or ride you accidentally stopped and saved halfway, or that kept recording after the finish. Works with files from Garmin, Suunto, Wahoo, Coros and others; the result uploads to Garmin Connect, Strava and other sports apps. Free and private: runs in your browser, files are never uploaded.
ui.tagline: Join two FIT files into one activity, or trim one
ui.lede: Stopped and saved your run or ride halfway by accident, or forgot to stop the watch at the end? Join the two activities back into one, as if you had paused instead of saving, or trim off what you didn’t mean to record. No data is lost.
ui.private: Your files stay on this device: everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
ui.privacy_h: Private: your files are never uploaded or stored
ui.privacy_more: There is no server that could receive them: fitstitch runs entirely in your browser, and once the page has loaded it even works offline. Nothing is stored either, except your language choice. Only if you ask for a map does the page load map images from OpenStreetMap, whose servers then see roughly where the activity was. The source code is open for anyone to check.
ui.export_p: On Garmin Connect, open each activity, then ⚙ → Export Original (you get a .zip). On Strava, open each activity, then ⋯ → Export Original. FIT files from other devices and apps (Suunto, Wahoo, Coros…) work too.
ui.export_note: The phone apps can't export files: use the websites, on a computer or in your phone's browser (if it keeps opening the app, ask for the desktop site).
ui.add_note: Add two or more files to join them into one activity, or a single file to trim its start or end.
ui.drop: Drop the .fit or .zip files here, or <u>choose files</u>
ui.load_failed: Could not load the Python runtime: {0}
ui.force: Stitch even if the sport or the device differ
ui.one_file: One file: you can trim its start or end. Add more files to stitch them together.
ui.trim_hint_end: Suggested: remove the last {0}, where you seem to have stood still or travelled at vehicle speed. Drag the handles on the chart to adjust.
ui.trim_hint_start: Suggested: remove the first {0}, before you seem to have started moving. Drag the handles on the chart to adjust.
ui.trim_hint_both: Suggested: remove the first {0} and the last {1}, where you seem to have stood still or travelled at vehicle speed. Drag the handles on the chart to adjust.
ui.trim_hint_none: Drag the handles on the chart, or type the times, to choose what to keep.
ui.map: Show a map (loads map images from OpenStreetMap, whose servers then see roughly where the activity was)
ui.removed: Removed {0} from the start and {1} from the end.
ui.verify_failed: Verification failed, so no file was produced. Please report this as a bug.
ui.replace_p: Delete the original parts first, wherever they were uploaded: Garmin Connect, Strava and most other apps reject an activity with the same start time as an existing one. Kudos, comments, photos and titles on the parts are lost. Then upload the stitched file to Garmin Connect (Import Data), Strava or any other app that accepts FIT files. If your apps sync with each other, uploading it to one may be enough.
